name: Vantage Fit
summary: Vantage Fit runs step, multi-activity and mindfulness challenges for employers, with participation analytics for boards. Its pricing page lists USD prices for 200 employees, from $1,600 for one 4-week Single Challenge to $3,200 a year for unlimited Basic challenges. The page prices only 200 employees.

facts.text: The homepage says Vantage Fit runs step, multi-activity, mindfulness and custom challenges for teams, regions or the whole organization.
The homepage lists a baseline health screening with aggregate insights, guided mindfulness and structured plans with the content behind them.
The homepage says participation, challenge and activity analytics are available for a board to read.
The pricing page shows Single Challenge Basic at 1,600 USD and Pro at 2,000 USD, each for 200 employees and one 4-week challenge.
The pricing page shows Unlimited Challenges Basic at 3,200 USD and Pro at 4,000 USD a year, each for 200 employees. It says unlimited challenges cost the same as two Single Challenges.

plans.name: Single Challenge, Basic
plans.notes: Daily step tracking only. The page does not state a billing period for this plan.

plans.name: Single Challenge, Pro
plans.notes: Counts several activities, such as walking, running, cycling and yoga. The page does not state a billing period for this plan.

plans.name: Unlimited Challenges, Basic
plans.notes: Unlimited step challenges for the year. Billed annually, according to the page.

plans.name: Unlimited Challenges, Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited challenges covering several activities. Billed annually, according to the page.

hiddenCosts: The page prices only 200 employees. A headcount slider runs from 25 to 1,000, but no amounts appear for other headcounts.
The page does not state taxes, setup fees, multi-year terms or whether monthly billing is available.
